content:
以太坊市场深度分析：多头信号占优，升级预期提振信心

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间二零二六年九月二十日中午十二点，以太坊报价二千五百八十五点二九美元，过去二十四小时内小幅下跌约百分之一点二。此前以太坊一度突破二千六百三十美元，创下一月份以来的最高水平，但随后受到鲸鱼大户向交易所转入三万三千一百八十枚以太坊（价值约七千万美元）的消息影响，价格出现短线回调。

从中期走势来看，以太坊在过去一个月内表现出明显的复苏态势。非空钱包数量创下两亿零七百一十七万的历史新高，超过四千万枚以太坊处于质押状态，网络参与度持续提升。以太坊ETF在九月十八日录得一点四三七亿美元的净流入，扭转了此前连续多日的流出趋势，表明传统金融机构对以太坊的兴趣正在回暖。

二、技术指标解读

从一小时级别的技术信号来看，当前十五个量化因子中有十个发出做多信号，仅五个发出做空信号，综合指标值为正一点二一，整体偏向看多，信号强度明显优于比特币。RSI指标发出做多信号，多个alpha因子一致看多，其中alpha11的做多信号胜率高达百分之五十九点一八，alpha15同样做多且胜率超过百分之六十一。

综合指标的做多胜率达到百分之八十，整体胜率百分之七十八点七二，信号体系表现出较高的可靠性。平均最大收益率为百分之一点一一，显示当前做多策略的盈亏比较为理想。不过需要警惕的是，短期RSI曾跌至二十六点五的超卖区域，表明短线抛压较重，价格可能在反弹前进一步探底。

从链上基本面来看，即将在十月六日登陆Sepolia测试网的Glamsterdam升级是重要的催化剂。该升级计划将Gas容量从六千万提升至两亿，实现三倍的性能飞跃。但开发团队也提示了构建者拍卖攻击的潜在风险，投资者需关注升级进展。此外，二层网络方案每日留存约四百五十万美元的手续费收入，但仅向主网结算约四十万美元，这对以太坊主网的价值捕获构成了一定挑战。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪整体偏向乐观。鲸鱼大户在二千四百九十二美元的成本基础上战略性地积累了九千枚以太坊，为价格提供了结构性支撑。ETH/BTC汇率的突破形态也让市场对以太坊的相对表现产生了更多期待。

从宏观环境来看，山寨币季节正在点燃市场热情。TOTAL3指数（扣除比特币和以太坊的加密市场总市值）在过去三十天内飙升超过百分之二十二，分析师认为如果比特币突破历史新高，资金可能大规模轮动至以太坊、中型代币和Meme币，推动加密市场总市值向十万至十二万亿美元迈进。

纽约证券交易所测试Avalanche基础设施用于代币化证券结算的消息，进一步验证了区块链在传统金融中的应用前景。美国证券交易委员会推出的五年创新豁免政策也为链上股票交易提供了监管空间，这对整个以太坊生态系统的长期发展构成利好。

总体来看，以太坊当前技术面多头占优，基本面升级预期明确，资金面机构回流。二千五百美元附近形成了较强的支撑位，上方二千六百三十美元是短期关键阻力。如果能够有效突破并站稳该位置，三千美元的目标将进入视野。建议投资者关注Glamsterdam升级进展和ETF资金流向，逢低布局，分批建仓。

ETH next chapter may not be “one more round of shilling,” but whether the Oct 6 Sepolia fork can keep the Glamsterdam framework running smoothly 🧩

Ethereum’s official roadmap is very clear: Glamsterdam is currently in devnet testing, the mainnet timeline is still TBA, and the next milestone is the Oct 6 Sepolia fork. What it aims to solve isn’t just an isolated parameter, but three things: more efficient parallel processing, more block propagation space, and bringing storage costs closer to the burden of real hardware. ePBS also plans to codify the handoff between proposer and builder into the protocol, reducing reliance on external intermediary layers, and to extend the effective propagation window from about 2 seconds to about 9 seconds.

Mechanically, this could improve L1 throughput and the validation experience; value capture, however, will depend on whether developers truly keep more activity on Ethereum, and whether the allocation among fees, staking, and MEV participants has shifted into a new balance. Today Binance spot is $ETH  about 2581, 24H -2.27—hold off on translating devnet milestones directly into price.

I’ll watch whether the Sepolia fork stays on schedule, whether clients are running smoothly, and whether application migrations deliver real incremental gains. If testing goes well but on-chain usage doesn’t catch up, the narrative will get ahead of itself; if compatibility issues arise, rollbacks will happen faster too. So—does Glamsterdam feel more like a scalability catalyst, or a valuation reshuffle?

📰 Why Are Miners Moving En Masse? The Survival Rules Behind ZetaChain’s Cross-Chain Migration

ZetaChain has announced it will abandon its in-house L1 network and migrate the ZETA token to the Solana ecosystem—essentially moving its “home” from the city center to the suburbs. For ZETA holders, it’s like relocating a game from a high-end arcade to a street-side stall: the upside is lower power consumption, while the downside is it may not feel as lively as before.

Why is this news important?
ZetaChain’s decision reflects the harsh reality of Layer 1 competition—without AI compute support, you can’t out-stack resources purely by throwing more at it than SOL. They’re sacrificing ZETA’s independent ecosystem in exchange for Solana’s compute “moat.” In plain terms, it’s a “survive” choice. Behind this is a snapshot of the Web3.0 wave: public chains shifting from “all-in-one” to “specialized and focused.” It also means it’s getting harder for pure-play L1 companies to make a living. Why? Because Ethereum and Solana have already figured out L2s in ways like Stacks and Aptos, so new public chains trying to build L1 from scratch can’t really compete.

Impact on the market
No direct impact on BTC/ETH, but it may affect ZETA token liquidity. In the short term, the ZETA price could drop by 10%-15% due to sentiment, since holders worry that the ecosystem might be left behind after the migration. In the long run, if Solana compute power truly increases ZETA’s transaction throughput, ZETA could regain an opportunity for a premium—but only if Solana’s compute capacity isn’t drained by other L2s. A similar historical example is when Polygon announced integration with Solana: MATIC saw short-term pressure, but benefited in the long run.

💡 My take: neutral to bearish for ZETA, but SOL compute demand will be squeezed. If ZETA’s trading volume drops by 50% within the next three months, this view is invalidated. This article has no sponsorship from any project. The author does not hold the assets mentioned

以太坊市场深度分析：升级预期支撑价格 短期仍面临考验

一、价格走势分析

截至2026年9月20日上午9时，以太坊现货价格报2582.26美元，过去24小时内下跌约2.5%。从小时级别K线来看，ETH在过去5个小时内呈现低位震荡格局，价格区间在2570至2587美元之间波动。

以太坊近期的下跌主要受到多重因素影响。首先，美国现货以太坊ETF出现周度净流出1.4亿美元，表明部分传统资本正在撤离。其次，技术面的破位引发了连锁反应，价格从2640美元快速下滑至2575美元，RSI一度进入超卖区域。

然而，以太坊的基本面依然强劲。链上数据显示，当前排队等待质押的ETH数量是申请退出的13.6倍，表明持有者对长期前景充满信心。此外，鲸鱼地址在价格下跌期间持续增持，为非空钱包数量创下2.0717亿个的新高纪录。目前超过4000万枚ETH处于质押状态，DeFi总锁仓量维持在约500亿美元的水平。

从技术升级角度来看，以太坊Glamsterdam升级已完成devnet-11排练，目标是将区块gas限制从6000万提升至2亿，实现近3倍的容量提升。Sepolia测试网的压力测试定于10月6日进行。这一升级预期为ETH价格提供了重要的基本面支撑。

二、技术指标解读

从技术指标来看，以太坊的综合指标显示看多信号，数值为1.93。在15个分析因子中，6个发出看多信号，9个因子指向看空，没有中性因子。看多比例为40%，看空比例为60%。虽然看空因子数量较多，但综合指标仍指向多头，表明看多因子的权重更大。

RSI指标显示短期超卖后有所反弹。RSI6为38.21，RSI12为37.69，均处于偏低区域，而RSI24为47.82，接近50中轴线。这表明短期超卖状况正在缓解，但中期动能仍然偏弱。

MACD指标虽然仍处于空头区域，但出现积极变化。MACD线为负9.78，信号线为负3.07，柱状图为负6.72。值得注意的是，柱状图的绝对值正在逐步收窄，从负10.15缩小至负6.72，暗示空头动能正在减弱，可能出现底部反转的信号。

布林带指标显示，当前价格位于中轨下方但接近下轨。上轨为2670美元，中轨为2613美元，下轨为2556美元。价格在下轨附近获得支撑，显示出一定的买盘力量。

移动平均线系统呈现空头排列。MA7为2579美元，MA25为2618美元，MA99为2522美元。短期均线位于长期均线下方，但MA99在下方形成支撑，表明长期趋势仍然向上。

抛物线SAR指标值为2620美元，位于当前价格上方，发出看空信号。超级趋势线指标值为2625美元，同样位于价格上方。不过，这两个指标与当前价格的差距正在缩小，暗示空头力量可能接近衰竭。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪呈现出谨慎乐观的特征。尽管短期面临技术面压力和ETF资金流出的挑战，但链上数据和升级预期为市场提供了坚实支撑。

从质押数据来看，13.6倍的质押申请比例表明持有者对以太坊的长期价值充满信心。这种"用脚投票"的行为比任何技术指标都更能反映市场的真实情绪。超过4000万枚ETH处于质押状态，占流通量的相当大比例，有效减少了市场上的可售供应。

鲸鱼动向是另一个值得关注的指标。在价格下跌期间，鲸鱼地址不仅没有抛售，反而持续增持。非空钱包数量创下2.0717亿个的新高，表明散户和机构都在积极布局。这种"聪明钱"的行为通常预示着价格底部的形成。

综合来看，以太坊短期可能在2550至2650美元区间内震荡整理。投资者应关注ETF资金流向的变化、Glamsterdam升级的进展，以及2509美元支撑位的防守情况。对于长期投资者而言，当前的回调可能提供了较好的布局机会，尤其是在升级预期和质押需求强劲的支撑下。

以太坊市场深度分析：升级预期支撑价格但短期风险犹存

2026年9月20日

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月二十日下午四时，以太坊现货报价两千五百七十七美元，过去五个小时内在两千五百七十一美元至两千五百八十九美元之间窄幅整理。从小时线来看，价格自凌晨的两千五百八十八美元小幅回落后，整体维持在两千五百七十五美元上方运行，表现出一定的抗跌性。当前价格已经跌破了七周期均线两千五百七十八美元和二十五周期均线两千六百二十美元，短期均线系统转为空头排列。

布林带下轨位于两千五百五十九美元，价格距离下轨仅有约十八美元的空间，若跌破下轨可能加速下行至两千五百美元附近。抛物线指标位于两千六百二十五美元上方，超级趋势线同样在两千六百二十四美元处形成压力。成交量方面，最近一个小时成交额约为一千万美元，呈现逐步递减的趋势，说明多空双方在当前价位均较为谨慎。

二、技术指标解读

动量指标方面，六周期RSI读数为二十六点零五，已经进入明显的超卖区域，十二周期RSI为三十二点五九，二十四周期RSI为四十六点零一，短周期指标的极端低位暗示卖压正在集中释放。MACD的DIFF线为负九点四二，信号线为负一点三五，柱状图为负八点零六，虽然空头动能仍在主导，但柱状图的绝对值从十点二零逐步收窄至八点零六，显示下跌动能正在减弱。

KDJ指标中K值为十八点零八，D值为十八点九五，J值为十六点三三，三线均处于二十以下的深度超卖区域。随机RSI为十三点七三，威廉指标为负八十三点零一，多个振荡指标同时进入极端低位，增加了技术性反弹的概率。从量化因子的综合评估来看，十五个因子中八个看多、七个看空，多空力量相对均衡，综合指标值为负零点五九，空头略占优势但优势并不明显。

三、市场情绪分析

基本面方面，以太坊Glamsterdam升级已完成第十一次开发网演练，计划将区块Gas上限从六千万提升至两亿，实现三倍的容量提升。Sepolia测试网的压力测试定于十月六日进行，这一升级路径为以太坊的中长期价值提供了坚实的技术支撑。目前已有超过四千万枚以太坊被质押，鲸鱼活动持续活跃，持有者总数创出历史新高。

然而风险同样不容忽视。现货ETF上周录得一点四亿美元的净流出，结束了此前连续四周的净流入态势，表明近期的价格支撑更多来自杠杆资金而非常规配置资金。从清算数据来看，若价格跌破两千五百零九美元，可能触发各大交易所累计约十一点五亿美元的多头清算。ETH/BTC比率的突破显示资金正在向山寨币轮动，近七成山寨币在过去一周跑赢比特币，这对以太坊生态中的中小市值代币形成利好。综合来看，以太坊短期面临技术性超卖反弹机会，但投资者需警惕两千五百美元关口的清算风险，中期关注Glamsterdam升级的落地进展。

｜Will the big pie and the second aunt drop at last, or not? Why can’t it fall? 😂
Many people squat here waiting for a pullback every day, and the result is the longer they wait, the more it rises. That really has exhausted the bears! Let’s chat about how the market looks right now.
First, let’s talk about BTC (the big pie). Current price: 81186.
It surged from 75975 to 81933—straight up by nearly 6000 points!
So many people were waiting for a sudden dip, but it just refuses to drop. Why?
It’s not just technical support:
1️⃣ The U.S. Treasury is “pushing liquidity,” with long-term U.S. Treasury yields trending downward, and money is flooding into risk assets like crazy;
2️⃣ Fed rate-hike expectations are cooling down directly—almost zero chance of a September hike;
3️⃣ This week, it broke through 78000 on heavy volume. The overhead trapped supply has basically been digested, and 80000 has turned into a strong support level;
4️⃣ Over the weekend, it traded with low volume and sideways action—no big selloff to smash it. Even if it wanted to drop, it has no strength.
⚠️ It’s not that it won’t fall—it’s just that it’s not the time yet!
Only if it effectively breaks below 80300 will it open up room for the downside. Targets: 80000 → 79500.
As long as it can steadily hold above 80300, the bullish structure stays intact, and pullbacks become opportunities to go long.
Now let’s look at ETH (the second aunt). Current price: 2629.
This week, it surged from 2412 to 2669—the gain is even stronger than BTC. When it rises, it means business!
So why can’t ETH fall either? Institutions are aggressively buying!
1️⃣ Spot ETH ETF net inflows in Q3 directly broke $10 billion; on September 11, single-day inflows were $216 million—BlackRock led the rush;
2️⃣ Corporate treasuries increased their ETH holdings by over $15 billion in Q3;
3️⃣ It’s rising faster than BTC, and its “anti-dip” attribute is fully on display during pullbacks.
Key short-term line in the sand: if it breaks below 2500, the short term turns bearish. Then watch for 2500 → 2460 on the downside.
As long as it stays above 2500, it’s still looking bullish. Pullbacks are worth keeping an eye on for possible opportunities.
To sum it up:
It’s not that BTC and ETH won’t drop. Right now, macro tailwinds are piling up, and institutional money keeps entering the market—so in the short term, it can’t drop.
But news comes fast and goes fast too. Next week, focus on Fed speeches—if they turn hawkish, a pullback could arrive at any time.

The only timeframe I trust right now is the daily. The 4H is chop with a downtrend tilt, but daily EMA7 at 2540 is still above EMA25 at 2441. That's the spine of the bullish case. title: 🚀 Ethereum (ETH): The Backbone of the Decentralized Economy
subTitle:
Ethereum (ETH) crypto market ka sab se important aur widely used blockchain projects mein se ek hai. Ethereum ne sirf digital currency ka concept nahi diya, balki Smart Contracts, DeFi, NFTs aur decentralized applications (dApps) ke liye ek powerful ecosystem create kiya.

🔹 ETH kya hai?
ETH, Ethereum network ki native cryptocurrency hai. Iska use transaction fees pay karne, decentralized applications use karne aur Ethereum ecosystem mein different activities ke liye hota hai.

🔹 Ethereum ki khas baat
Ethereum ki sab se badi strength iska smart-contract platform hona hai. Developers Ethereum blockchain par decentralized applications aur financial services build kar sakte hain, bina kisi central authority ke.

🔹 ETH aur Staking
Ethereum Proof-of-Stake mechanism par operate karta hai. Users apne ETH ko stake karke network ki security mein contribute kar sakte hain aur rewards earn karne ka opportunity pa sakte hain.

🔹 DeFi aur Ethereum
Decentralized Finance (DeFi) ecosystem mein Ethereum ka bohat bada role hai. Lending, borrowing, decentralized exchanges aur doosri financial applications Ethereum infrastructure par operate karti hain.

🔹 Ethereum ka future
Ethereum ki future growth scalability, lower transaction costs, Layer-2 networks aur ecosystem adoption se closely connected hai. Agar Ethereum apni technology ko continuously improve karta raha aur developers ka interest strong raha, to ETH crypto industry mein apni important position maintain kar sakta hai.

📌 Conclusion:
Ethereum sirf ek cryptocurrency nahi, balki ek complete blockchain ecosystem hai. ETH ki value ko samajhne ke liye Ethereum network, its adoption, development activity aur overall crypto market ko bhi consider karna zaroori hai.

⚠️ Note: Crypto market highly volatile hai. Investment se pehle apni research zaroor karein.

Ethereum Market In-Depth Analysis: Testing Pullback After Breaking Through 2,600 Yuan

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of September 20, 2026, Ethereum’s current quote is $2,579. Over the past 24 hours, it has fluctuated narrowly between $2,570 and $2,591. Recently, ETH briefly broke above $2,630, reaching the highest level since January, but subsequently fell back for an adjustment.

From the driving factors perspective, on-chain activity on the Ethereum network has continued to strengthen. The number of non-empty wallets has hit a historical high of 207.17 million, the total amount of staked ETH has exceeded 40 million coins, and whale activity has increased markedly. These data suggest that Ethereum’s ecosystem fundamentals are continuously improving.

The upcoming GlAmsterdam upgrade is an important catalyst that the market is watching closely. The upgrade is scheduled to go live on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, aiming to raise the gas limit from 60 million to 200 million, enabling threefold scaling (3x). Although developers have flagged potential risks related to builder auctions, this upgrade marks an important step forward for Ethereum in terms of scalability.

II. Interpretation of Technical Indicators

The moving average system shows: the 7-period moving average is at $2,584, the 25-period moving average at $2,622, and the 99-period moving average at $2,518. The current price has already fallen below the short-term and mid-term moving averages, but it remains above the long-term moving average, indicating a short-term weakness while still having support in the medium to long term.

Regarding the MACD indicator: the DIFF value is -8.41, the DEA is 0.66, and the histogram is -9.07. The MACD line has dropped below the zero axis. Bearish momentum dominates, and in the short term, it is important to watch whether a stabilization signal may appear.

The RSI indicator shows: the 6-period RSI is 25.03, the 12-period RSI is 32.16, and the 24-period RSI is 45.85. The short-term RSI has already plunged into oversold territory, suggesting conditions for a technical rebound similar to Bitcoin, but the bearish trend has not clearly reversed yet.

The Bollinger Bands indicator shows the upper band at $2,673, the middle band at $2,618, and the lower band at $2,564. Price action is running between the middle and lower bands, nearing lower-band support.

The KDJ indicator: the K value is 17.68, the D value is 19.38, and the J value is 14.27. All three lines are in a deep oversold region. The Williams %R (WR) is -85.06, also in the oversold range, implying that the probability of a short-term rebound is increasing.

The Parabolic SAR indicator is at $2,630, far above the current price, continuously emitting bearish signals. The SuperTrend indicator is at $2,623 as well—also above the price—confirming a short-term downward trend.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

On the positive side, there are signals of large whale buys on-chain: a single entity has accumulated more than 9,058 ETH, showing a strong willingness to buy the dip. There are also signs of a breakthrough in the ETH-to-BTC exchange rate, suggesting that capital may be rotating from Bitcoin to Ethereum. In addition, the progress of crypto legislation and the market’s resilience to rate hikes provide fundamental support for ETH.

Key risks need to be closely monitored. There are clear signs of technical weakness: the RSI has fallen to an extreme oversold level near 22, and the MACD remains negative. More importantly, if ETH breaks below the key support at $2,509, it could trigger a bull liquidation waterfall as large as $1.147 billion, which would be the biggest downside risk in the short term.

Institutional sentiment is showing divergence: the Ethereum ETF saw an outflow of $140 million in a single week, ending the prior streak of net inflows for four consecutive weeks. This shift is worth paying attention to, but if the network upgrade proceeds smoothly and on-chain data continues to improve, the return of funds may just be a matter of time.

Overall, Ethereum is at the intersection of technical oversold conditions and improving fundamentals. Short-term pullback pressure still exists, but expectations for the GlAmsterdam upgrade and record-high on-chain activity provide solid support for the medium-term outlook. It is recommended to watch the key support level at $2,509 and the resistance level at $2,630.

以太坊市场深度分析：两千六百元突破后的回调考验

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年九月二十日，以太坊当前报价二千五百七十九美元，过去二十四小时在二千五百七十美元至二千五百九十一美元之间窄幅波动。近期ETH曾一度突破二千六百三十美元，创下自一月份以来的最高水平，但随后出现回落调整。

从驱动因素来看，以太坊网络的链上活跃度持续走强。非空钱包数量创下二点零七一七亿的历史新高，质押ETH总量超过四千万枚，鲸鱼活动显著增加。这些数据表明以太坊生态的基本面正在持续改善。

即将到来的Glamsterdam升级是市场关注的重要催化剂。该升级计划于十月六日在Sepolia测试网上线，目标是将Gas限制从六千万提升至两亿，实现三倍的扩容。虽然开发者提示了构建者拍卖方面的潜在风险，但这一升级标志着以太坊在可扩展性方面迈出了重要一步。

二、技术指标解读

移动均线系统显示，七周期均线位于二千五百八十四美元，二十五周期均线位于二千六百二十二美元，九十九周期均线位于二千五百一十八美元。当前价格已经跌破短期和中期均线，但仍位于长期均线上方，呈现短期偏弱但中长期仍有支撑的格局。

MACD指标方面，DIFF值为负八点四一，DEA值为零点六六，柱状图为负九点零七。MACD线已经跌至零轴下方，空头动能占据主导，短期内需要关注是否会出现企稳信号。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI为二十五点零三，十二周期RSI为三十二点一六，二十四周期RSI为四十五点八五。短期RSI已深入超卖区域，与比特币类似存在技术性反弹的条件，但空头趋势尚未明确扭转。

布林带指标显示上轨位于二千六百七十三美元，中轨位于二千六百一十八美元，下轨位于二千五百六十四美元。价格运行在布林带中下轨之间，接近下轨支撑。

KDJ指标中K值为十七点六八，D值为十九点三八，J值为十四点二七，三线均处于深度超卖区域。威廉指标WR为负八十五点零六，同样处于超卖区间，暗示短期反弹概率在增加。

抛物线SAR指标位于二千六百三十美元，远高于当前价格，持续发出看空信号。超级趋势指标位于二千六百二十三美元，同样位于价格上方，确认短期下行趋势。

三、市场情绪分析

利好方面，链上出现大额鲸鱼买入信号，单一实体累计吸筹超过九千零五十八枚ETH，显示出强烈的逢低买入意愿。ETH对BTC的汇率出现突破迹象，暗示资金可能正在从比特币向以太坊轮动。此外，加密立法推进和市场对加息的韧性为ETH提供了基本面支撑。

风险方面需要重点关注。技术面出现明显走弱信号，RSI跌至二十二附近的极端超卖水平，MACD持续为负。更关键的是，如果ETH跌破二千五百零九美元的关键支撑位，可能触发高达十一点四七亿美元的多头清算瀑布，这将是短期内最大的下行风险。

机构情绪方面出现分化，以太坊ETF单周流出一点四亿美元，结束了此前连续四周的净流入态势。这一转变值得关注，但如果网络升级顺利推进且链上数据持续改善，资金回流只是时间问题。

综合来看，以太坊正处于技术面超卖与基本面改善的交汇点。短期回调压力依然存在，但Glamsterdam升级预期和创纪录的链上活跃度为中期走势提供了坚实支撑。建议关注二千五百零九美元的关键支撑位和二千六百三十美元的阻力位。

📰 FCA just said it will open the gates—yet crypto is still falling: can this window really hold?

Just a couple of days ago, we heard that the FCA (the UK Financial Conduct Authority) plans to open the doors for cryptocurrencies. But today, the crypto market is still dropping. Specifically, UK regulators said they will simplify the compliance process for the operation of digital asset businesses, yet Bitcoin and Ethereum are still falling. This shows the market doesn’t buy this kind of “talking-point bullish news,” and the FCA’s promises haven’t reassured investors.

Why is this news important?
When the FCA suddenly signals it will allow crypto to proceed, it’s essentially trying to restore market confidence. But honestly, the real reason regulators are easing up isn’t what the FCA said today—it’s that traditional financial markets (like expectations for Fed rate cuts) have already flooded the liquidity pool. The crypto market right now is like an edge player. If the FCA gives a positive signal to crypto alone, others simply don’t care. Why? Because the link between crypto and traditional finance is strengthening fast, while the space for regulatory arbitrage is getting smaller and smaller. This means the FCA’s move this time is more like “plugging a leak” rather than “opening the gates.”

Impact on the market
For the BTC/ETH price, this headline is basically meaningless. There may be a rebound in the short term, but the FCA commitment changes little. If tomorrow the Fed announces a 50-basis-point rate cut and Bitcoin breaks 80K immediately, that would show the market never took the FCA seriously. In terms of the regulatory environment, this kind of statement won’t change the situation of big money continuing to flow into AI and tech stocks. Historically, rebounds after regulatory negative news being priced in have usually been within 5%, and they don’t last longer than about two weeks.

📰 刚说FCA要开大门，结果币圈还在跌：这个窗口到底能不能撑住？

前两天刚说过FCA（英国金融行为监管局）要给加密货币开大门，结果今天币圈照样跌。具体是英国监管机构表示会简化对数字资产运营的监管流程，但比特币和以太坊还是继续掉。这说明市场不认这种"嘴炮利好"，FCA的承诺还没让投资者放心。

为什么这条新闻重要？
FCA突然放话说要给加密货币放行，其实是想挽回市场信心。但说实话，监管松绑的根本原因不在于FCA今天说了什么，而在于传统金融市场（比如美联储的降息预期）已经把资金池撑爆了。加密市场现在就像个边缘玩家，你FCA单独给利好，别人根本不care。为什么？因为加密和传统金融的关联性正在快速增强，但监管套利空间已经越来越小。这意味着FCA的这次操作更像是在"补漏洞"，而不是"开大门"。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH价格来说，这个利好基本等于白给。短期内可能有个反弹，但FCA的承诺意味着不了什么。如果明天美联储宣布降息50个基点，比特币直接破80K，那说明市场根本没把FCA放在眼里。对监管环境来说，这是欧洲在"卡位竞争"（为什么？因为美国和UK都在抢第一桶金）。资金流向看，这种监管表态不会改变大钱继续往AI和科技股跑的局面。历史上看，监管利空兑现后的反弹基本都在5%以内，而且维持不超过两周。

操作思路
我个人认为，这个FCA消息短期有个情绪脉冲，但长期看空。如果比特币接下来跌破79K，这个判断就作废。简单说：监管利好之所以没用，是因为加密市场已经习惯了"政策市"，但这次FCA的力度还不够打消大家对于"风险收益比"的疑虑。

【Greed Index off the charts, yet ETH is pulling back—I've seen this signal too many times】

A week ago it was still hovering around 2800, and now it’s back to wobbling in the 2600s. One month ago? 3400. The numbers are right there: moving around by 200 points for a whole month, while market sentiment has quietly climbed to 71.

What does 71 mean? It’s the Greed zone—one breath away from euphoria. But ETH isn’t following the frenzy; instead, it’s started dropping.

Honestly, I’ve seen this kind of divergence more than once. Each time, it basically comes down to two things: either smart money is distributing and waiting for retail to rush in and become the bag-holder; or big capital is suppressing the price to accumulate, with a major move brewing behind the scenes. Combined with the news I’ve seen over the past couple of days—Ethlabs proposing to shorten Ethereum block time, saying that increased institutional activity requires higher efficiency—I lean toward the latter.

But the key question is whether this “increased institutional activity” can actually be implemented.

Cutting block time from 12 seconds to 8 seconds—or even shorter—sounds like a small change, but in reality it shifts the performance foundation of the entire Ethereum network. For high-frequency DeFi strategies, L2 cross-chain bridges, and MEV bots, this improvement translates directly into real profit. But for ordinary coin holders? You won’t feel a difference in the short term.

So whether this actually gets going depends on whether the Ethereum Foundation and miners/validators are on board. In the past, proposals like this have been raised more than once, but very few have truly made it to implementation.

Now ETH is consolidating in the 2516–2708 range. My take is: it’s not time to decide on the direction yet, but the probability of a move upward is higher. The premise is that institutions come in with real money—not just lingering at the proposal stage.

What do you think about this move right now? Do you believe the proposal will be implemented, or is it just another sales pitch?

content:
【贪婪指数爆表，ETH却在回调——这个信号我见过太多次了】

一周前还在2800附近磨蹭，现在又回到2600多晃悠，一个月前？3400。数据摆在这儿，上下200点折腾了一个月，市场情绪却悄悄爬到了71。

71什么概念？贪婪区，离狂热就差一口气。但ETH没有跟着疯，反而开始往下掉。

说真的，这种背离我见过不止一次。每次出现基本就两件事：要么是聪明钱在出货，等韭菜冲进来接盘；要么是大资金在压价吸货，后面憋大招。结合这两天看到的消息——Ethlabs提议缩短以太坊区块时间，说机构活动增加需要更高的效率——我倾向于后者。

但这个"机构活动增加"能不能真落地才是关键。

区块时间从12秒压到8秒甚至更短，听着是小事，实际上动了整个以太坊的性能底座。对那些高频DeFi策略、L2的跨链桥、MEV机器人来说，这点提升是实打实的利润。但对普通持币者？短期内感受不到变化。

所以这东西能不能真跑起来，要看以太坊基金会和矿工/验证者买不买单。历史上这类提案提了不止一次，真正落地的不多。

现在ETH在2516-2708这个区间震荡，我的判断是：还没到方向的时候，但往上走的概率更大。前提是机构真金白银进来，而不是只停留在提案层面。

你现在怎么看这波？觉得提案能落地，还是又在画饼？

📰 AI uncovers old vulnerabilities: why the “security myth” of cryptocurrencies is starting to crack?

In 2026, AI researchers dug up several old vulnerabilities in cryptocurrencies: one is a four-year-old Zcash flaw that could be used to counterfeit coins; another is a weakness in “cold wallets” from 2021 that led to over $100 million worth of Bitcoin being stolen; and there was also an incident where AI was compromised, resulting in the transfer of 3 billion DRB coins. These long-standing issues expose potential systemic risks in crypto security defenses—so much so that even AI may not be able to fully see everything.

Why is this news important?
Vulnerability detection in crypto has long depended on the community’s spontaneous actions. This time, AI “re-reads the code” and finds old problems. The root cause is that the industry lacks unified security standards. It’s like vehicle recalls: crypto’s “recall mechanism” is weak—only after hackers make big money from vulnerabilities do projects fix them. That means smart contracts deployed over the past four years may generally have hidden risks. Meanwhile, AI can automatically scan, greatly lowering the cost of discovering vulnerabilities. This hits the crypto security myth directly. What does that mean? Even code written by the top developers could still be attacked via details that AI overlooks from a human perspective.

Impact on the market
In the short term, it may pressure sentiment around BTC and ETH. But more importantly, it could shake the foundation of long-term trust. Data shows the current Fear & Greed Index is 55 (neutral). However, this event may lead investors to start questioning: the coins you hold now—could they also have undiscovered “time bombs”? For historical context: in 2018, vulnerabilities in Ethereum smart contracts led to the The DAO incident, and the coin price then crashed by 60%. The difference this time is that the attack methods are more covert—not actively exploited by hackers, but automatically found by AI—which could mean a wider impact. Regulators may use this opportunity to speed up legislation for crypto asset oversight, such as mandatory code audits. In terms of capital flows, funds may move out of higher-risk coins and into safer assets like bonds.

Approach
I believe in the short term, this news will weigh on BTC and ETH sentiment. But in the long run, it’s negative that clears the way for healthy industry development—the bad is out of the system. If, in the next two weeks, BTC stabilizes at the $80,623.13 support level, and if demand for Ethereum smart contract audits increases significantly, then this view would be invalid. For now, it’s suitable to remain cautiously observant—no need to panic-sell—but it’s necessary to reassess the long-term holdings of crypto projects. One-sentence translation: AI is like a ground-penetrating radar that detects underground water; old mine shafts that were invisible before can now be found.

PEPE 这个老牌狗链突然在 Solana 上暴走，一天交易量冲上 4000 万美元。这背后不是简单的换赛道，而是 Solana 网络的崛起为 Meme 代币打开了新窗口，也暴露出其他链在成本和速度上的短板。对普通投资者来说，这意味着新的赚钱机会，但对整个行业可能是更深层次的竞争警钟。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次 PEPE 的 Solana 爆发根本原因在于区块链网络性能的差异化竞争。Solana 的 TPS（每秒交易处理量）和极低成本，让像 PEPE 这样的快速炒作 Meme 代币找到了更合适的温床。对比 BTC/ETH 的拥堵和 Gas 费，以及 BNB Chain 的性能瓶颈，PEPE 这种高频波动的资产在 Solana 上能更自由地流动。这意味着资金正在从性能欠佳的链向 Solana 这样的高性能网络转移，这不仅是 PEPE 的胜利，更是对整个链生态的重新洗牌。

对市场的影响
短期看，这对 BTC/ETH 的影响是情绪层面的。虽然 PEPE 在 Solana 上表现亮眼，但 Meme 代币的波动性本质不会改变，且 Solana 本身也面临生态增长缓慢和潜在监管风险。中期来看，如果 Solana 能持续吸引类似 PEPE 这样的高频资金，可能会挑战目前以太坊的 Meme 代币定价权。历史上类似事件，比如 Doge 在以太坊的统治地位被 Shiba Inu 取代，都显示了 Meme 代币的轮动规律。

💡 这次 PEPE 的 Solana 爆发，对整个市场意味着 Meme 代币的战场正在加速迁移到高性能网络上。如果未来 1 周内 Solana 网络费用开始显著上涨，或者出现大规模监管警告，这个判断作废。

📰 Oil Crisis Pushes BTC Back to 81K? Why This Bond Selloff Turned Around Matters So Much for Crypto?

On Friday at the U.S. stock market open, the price of Bitcoin suddenly surged, briefly breaking through $81,000. This happened at the same time as U.S. 30-year Treasury yields rebounded, with the trigger for the yield rise being renewed volatility in global oil prices. Bitcoin investors partly attributed the move to a return of safe-haven capital to traditional markets.

Why is this news important?
U.S. Treasury yields are seen as a global benchmark for asset pricing—especially long-term 30-year Treasuries, which reflect the market’s long-term expectations for inflation and monetary policy. While this yield rebound was triggered by the oil crisis, what matters more is that it suggests the Fed’s rate-hiking cycle may be nearing its end. That’s because persistently high oil prices force the Fed to reconsider its tightening plans. As “digital gold,” Bitcoin is highly sensitive to the Fed’s policy direction, so changes in Treasury yields often become a gauge of market sentiment.

For BTC, this means the market is reassessing how to allocate risk assets. Money may shift between traditional safe-haven assets and crypto safe-haven assets. If inflation expectations continue to run out of control, in theory, both gold and Bitcoin could rise together. The key difference is that gold has physical reserves, whereas Bitcoin’s “safe-haven” characteristics are largely the result of market consensus.

Market impact
In the short term, Bitcoin’s rise may be more of a spillover effect—money flowing back into traditional safe-haven assets such as bonds. But if the Fed truly slows its rate hikes due to oil prices, this positive signal could spread from the bond market to a wider range of asset classes, including cryptocurrencies. Historically, when the Fed shifts toward easier monetary policy, Bitcoin’s rallies often last for several weeks.

Over the long term, this event could reshape investors’ understanding of crypto: no longer purely a speculative product, but to a certain extent possessing “macroeconomic asset” characteristics. This depends on how long the oil crisis lasts. If high oil prices become the norm, the continued presence of inflation expectations would support risk assets, including Bitcoin.

Trading/investment approach
I believe this Bitcoin rally has a solid foundation. If the Fed truly starts moving toward easing, Bitcoin could stabilize above $82,000. But that view depends on oil prices not continuing to surge out of control. If OPEC+ cuts production again (the market currently expects a cut in November), inflation expectations could be further suppressed, and Bitcoin’s upside would be limited by the strength of traditional safe-haven assets.

📰 美油危机又把BTC推上81K？为什么这次债券止跌对加密这么重要？

周五美股开盘时，比特币价格突然拉升，一度突破81,000美元。这发生在美国30年期国债收益率反弹的同一时间，而债息上涨的诱因是全球原油价格再次出现波动。比特币投资者把这次上涨部分归功于避险资金回流传统市场。

为什么这条新闻重要？
美国国债收益率被视为全球资产定价的锚，尤其是30年期长期国债更是反映了市场对通胀和货币政策的长期预期。这次收益率反弹，虽然由原油危机触发，但更重要的是，它暗示美联储加息周期可能接近尾声——因为油价持续高企迫使美联储不得不重新评估紧缩计划。比特币作为"数字黄金"，对美联储政策动向高度敏感，因此国债收益率变化往往成为它的情绪风向标。

对BTC来说，意味着市场正在重新评估风险资产配置，传统避险资产和加密避险资产之间可能发生资金转移。如果通胀预期继续失控，理论上会同时推高黄金和比特币。但关键的区别在于，黄金有实物储备，而比特币的"避险属性"更多是市场共识的结果。

对市场的影响
短期内，比特币上涨可能更多是资金回流债券等传统避险资产的溢出效应。但如果美联储真的因油价而放缓加息步伐，这种利好可能从债券市场传导到更广泛的资产类别，包括加密货币。历史上看，当美联储货币政策转向宽松时，比特币的反弹往往能持续数周。

长期来看，这次事件可能改变投资者对加密货币的认知：不再是纯粹的投机品，而是具备了某种程度的"宏观资产"属性。这取决于原油危机的持续时间，如果高油价成为常态，那么通胀预期的持续存在将支撑包括比特币在内的风险资产。

操作思路
我认为这次比特币上涨具有实质性基础，如果美联储真的开始转向宽松，比特币有望在$82,000上方企稳。但这个判断的前提是油价不能继续飙升失控。如果OPEC+再次减产（目前市场预期11月可能减产），通胀预期可能被进一步压制，比特币的上涨空间就会受限于传统避险资产的强度。

$ETH #ETH  At present, it’s more suitable to first confirm a rebound rather than define a reversal in advance. Current price is 2,596.06; 1 hour: +0.40%, 24 hours: -1.59%. Whether the two cycles align in the same direction again is the key focus going forward.

Right now, with 1 hour at +0.40% and 24 hours at -1.59%, the two cycles have not formed sufficiently clear same-direction coordination. In a range-bound market, the tolerance for chasing or panic-selling is low. It’s better to confirm direction using the upper boundary, confirm follow-through using the lower boundary holding; the midline is only used as a strong/weak dividing line.

If the rebound can recapture 2,616.17 and then further hold above 2,668, it would indicate that buy-side demand has started to change the prior weak structure. But if price reaches the midline and then falls back again—especially if it drops back toward 2,564.33—then it looks more like a failed repair, and you shouldn’t keep relying on a bullish-strength expectation.

Even if you want to confirm the rebound has failed, you still need evidence. You can’t just chase a short immediately just because of one spike-and-drop. A more reasonable sequence is to observe whether the resistance level blocks price, whether the lows start moving down again, and then decide based on whether the subsequent retracement recovers the key level.

For those already holding positions, the focus is to manage based on whether support has truly failed—not to be carried around by every fluctuation. For those without positions, prioritize waiting for a breakout and retest, or support confirmation. Spot holdings can be scaled in batches; for derivatives, you should shorten the decision chain—first determine the stop-loss level, then decide whether to participate.

Risk control should still come before the conclusion: only execute when conditions appear, and re-evaluate immediately when the price invalidates. The larger the volatility, the more you must restrain your position size per trade. The above is a scenario analysis based on the current 1-hour and 24-hour data, and it does not constitute any promise of returns.

I read an old saying and suddenly it clicked with today’s market.

In *One Up on Wall Street* (Peter Lynch’s successful investing), there’s a principle: 
Lynch says you should buy what you understand. In crypto, most people buy coins they can’t even explain what problem they solve. If you can’t clarify in one sentence why it should go up, then what you’re buying isn’t an asset—it’s just chips.

Take today’s $ETH  as an example: right now it’s 2,593, and over the last 24h it’s -1.68%. This kind of market action perfectly confirms the lesson above. It’s not a coincidence—it's human nature repeating itself on the chart.

The market won’t show you mercy just because you understand the principle.
Wait for signals, not your mood.

🔒HOW TO PROTECT YOUR CRYPTO ACCOUNT — SIMPLE STEPS THAT ACTUALLY WORK 🛡️ 

Protecting your $BTC starts with the basics most people still skip. Enable strong two-factor authentication using an authenticator app (never SMS), create unique and complex passwords for every exchange, and treat your email account like the master key to everything. 

Once the foundations are solid, move to the middle layer with $ETH. Keep only what you need for trading on exchanges or hot wallets. Transfer the rest to a hardware wallet so your private keys stay offline. Never type your seed phrase into any website, chat, or “support” message — no legitimate platform will ever ask for it.

Finish strong by locking down $LINK and the rest of your portfolio. Turn on withdrawal address whitelists, set daily withdrawal limits where available, and double-check every transaction before you sign. Regularly revoke old smart-contract approvals and stay alert for phishing links that look almost identical to real sites. 

🧠THE BIGGER PICTURE   
Most losses don’t come from broken cryptography. They come from weak habits: reused passwords, SMS 2FA, shared seed phrases, and trusting unsolicited DMs. Hardware wallets, offline seed backups (preferably on metal), and strict separation between trading and long-term holdings close the biggest attack routes.

News and market moves will always create FOMO, but nothing protects your capital better than consistent security discipline.

📰 Why did Ethereum ETF suddenly add $29.4 million? Fidelity didn’t play by the usual rules

On Friday, ETF data showed that net inflows into Ethereum ETFs unexpectedly increased by $29.4 million, with Fidelity standing out. Normally, inflows of this size would push the price of ETH higher—yet ETH continued to fall. So is the market betting on the ETF’s long-term potential, or is this simply short-term profit-taking? What does it imply for the entire crypto market?

Why is this news important?
This ETF inflow occurred amid a backdrop of continued declines in ETH’s price, breaking the simple logic of “ETF inflows = price rises.” The core reason may be that Fidelity, a traditional industry giant, has entered the scene and could change the way ETF capital flows. Previously, ETF inflows were often driven by short-term speculative funds, while Fidelity represents longer-term allocation power. This shift could alter market supply-and-demand dynamics. Combined with the fact that BTC is also falling, it suggests capital may be moving away from short-term hotspots (such as tech stocks) toward safer havens or value-oriented strategies.

Market impact
In the short term, the $29.4 million inflow was absorbed by ETH’s decline, meaning other funds may be taking the opposite side. This implies stronger support below ETH, or that sell pressure is coming from other ETFs or the spot market. BTC’s impact appears limited, but it hints that the bullish main theme may still hold. In the long term, if Fidelity continues to add to positions, the total ETF size could break a critical threshold, potentially triggering a spiral-like rise in ETF demand. However, this depends on a still-relaxed regulatory environment. At present, expectations for further Fed rate hikes remain—the main factor weighing on sentiment.

Trading/thinking approach
💡 If Fidelity continues to increase its ETF exposure and ETH holds the $2,600 support level, this $29.4 million could become an important source of buy pressure. But if regulation tightens or market panic accelerates, ETF inflows could evaporate instantly. That means staying cautious in the near term and watching whether the $2,500–$2,700 range can hold. If it breaks below $2,500, the bullish thesis behind the ETF inflow would be invalidated.

周五ETF数据显示，Ethereum ETF资金流入意外增加2940万美元，其中Fidelity基金表现突出。按常理，这种规模流入应该推动ETH价格反弹，但 ETH反而继续下跌。这背后是资金在押注ETF长期潜力，还是短期获利了结？对整个加密市场有何深意？

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次ETF资金流入发生在ETH价格持续下跌的背景下，打破了"ETF流入=价格涨"的简单逻辑。根本原因在于：Fidelity作为传统巨头入局，可能改变ETF资金流向模式。以往ETF资金多为短期投机资金，而Fidelity代表长期配置力量，这种转变可能改变市场供需结构。结合目前BTC也在下跌，暗示资金正在从短期热点（如科技股）撤离，转向避险或价值投资。

对市场的影响
短期看，2940万美元流入被ETH下跌吸收，意味着其他资金正在反向操作。这意味着ETH下方支撑较强，或者抛压来自其他ETF或现货市场。对BTC影响较小，但暗示牛市主线仍在。长期看，如果Fidelity持续流入，ETF总规模可能突破临界点，引发ETF螺旋式上涨。但前提是监管环境持续宽松，目前美联储加息预期仍在，这是主要压制因素。

The trading activity of Robinhood Chain is not the same as the fees it has paid to Ethereum.

Since the end of April, Robinhood Chain has processed over 600 million transactions; over the same period, the on-chain fees it paid to Ethereum were only about $49,000. On September 3 alone, it charged users about $4.5 million in transaction fees, while the data and proof costs paid to Ethereum were about $400. One observation is that if L2 activity continues to rise, the “app-chain business model” narrative will become even stronger. Another observation is that if ETH can only capture very small blob fees, the controversy over value capture on the mainnet will continue. $4M (about 28 million RMB) — this is the total prize pool for Binance’s newly launched “Trading Competition Season 4.” It covers four tracks: Spot, Futures (Perpetual/Contracts), TradFi Futures, and bStocks. The competition started on September 9 and ends on October 7.

【How the prize pool is split】
Each of the four tracks has its own ranking, competing based on trading volume or ROI:
• Spot track: 1,200 BNB (two rounds; 600 BNB per round)
• Futures track: 1,416 BNB (also two rounds)
• TradFi Futures track: 500,000 USDC
• bStocks track: 708 BNB
• Referral + New User tasks: 1,000,000 USDC

You read that right—referral tasks alone total 1 million USDC. Invite friends to register and complete $100 in trading volume, and you and your friend can each get the top $10 USDC voucher. For the bStocks new-user track, trading $20 earns you a share of a 500,000 USDC prize pool—each person can earn up to $5.

【Participation requirements】
• All regular users who have completed KYC can join the Spot track
• The Futures / TradFi / bStocks tracks require VIP 1–6
• Tap “Register Now” on the event page—no additional eligibility needed
• For the Futures track, you must have at least $25,000 in trading volume to qualify for the ranking

【Countdown】
Round 1: Sep 9–Sep 23 (9 days left)
Round 2: Sep 23–Oct 7
Hop in now—Round 1 rankings haven’t really taken off yet, so the window is optimal.

【Is it worth going for?】
It depends on the track. The referral tasks have zero barriers for “free farming.” $10 isn’t much, but the certainty is the best part. The bStocks new-user track has less competition and a larger prize pool—$20 trading volume is a very low threshold, making it the best value. The Futures track requires a $25K volume baseline, which suits big players aiming for top rankings. The Spot track offers 600 BNB per round, so mid-sized traders still have a chance.

Bottom line: If you’re a bStocks new user or you’re willing to do referrals, this is absolutely worth “going for.” For the Futures track, trade within your means—don’t force fees just to chase rankings.

📰 Russian Central Bank New Rule: Crypto Asset Capital Cap of 1% — Are Banks Afraid?

The Bank of Russia recommends that banks use only 1% of their capital to trade in cryptocurrencies. Foreign digital assets are also covered. However, customer funds aren’t counted as risk, but the bank’s own purchases aren’t—banks will need to calculate the risk more heavily (1.25x). The new rule could be implemented in the fourth quarter of next year.

Why is this news important?
This isn’t just about Russia—it throws a stone into the global pond. Why is the Russian central bank suddenly clamping down so tightly? Put simply: crypto is too volatile. When the Russian ruble crashed last year, many banks managed to avoid losses through crypto, but now they feel the risk is too high and want to pull back. This means regulators are starting to truly worry that cryptocurrencies could become a systemic risk. It also connects to recent discussions in various countries about unified regulation of cryptocurrencies.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this may reduce the volume of local crypto trading in Russia. But globally, if other countries follow suit, Bitcoin and Ethereum could see some sentiment pressure. For example, if banks reduce their crypto allocation, some Bitcoin positions may be sold. However, in the long run, as long as cryptocurrencies remain an investment tool, the money still has to go somewhere. That implies large capital may be more willing to place funds in coins with lower volatility and more regulation-friendly profiles.

💡 My take is that this new rule will affect ETH more than BTC. Why? Because ETH is a protocol coin—it’s more like a tech stock—so banks may think they understand it better. But this view has conditions under which it could fail: if the United States also issues a similar policy, or if the Russian central bank later changes its mind, then the view becomes invalid.

📰 Why does this Bitcoin service company want to learn from JPMorgan?

Strategy CEO Phong Le says the company’s goal is not just to be a Bitcoin custodian, but to become a “JPMorgan” in the Bitcoin space. He shared with ChainCatcher that the company is building a digital-asset ecosystem designed to serve 8 billion people, and that its digital credit ecosystem has already reached a size of $15B. Le specifically mentioned designing products, building markets, and providing liquidity—essentially aiming to replicate the complete chain of traditional finance.

Strategy wants to turn itself into a full financial-services provider in the Bitcoin industry, covering everything from lending to trading. They currently have $15B in credit business, with the goal of serving most people worldwide. It’s similar to the way traditional banks (e.g., JPMorgan) enter the crypto market—but this time with Bitcoin at the core.

In-depth analysis

Why is this news important?
Strategy’s positioning is significant, as it suggests crypto services are moving beyond simple trading/custody toward more complex financial services. Behind this is evidence that Bitcoin’s value-storing attributes are gaining recognition from more institutions. If Bitcoin is “digital gold,” then related demand for borrowing, investing, and other derivative needs may surge. Meanwhile, a more stable regulatory environment (for example, the U.S. may create a clear path for Crypto on its own) also encourages platforms like this to develop. In essence, they’re helping Bitcoin secure more “bank-like” roles.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this could boost sentiment for the Bitcoin sector, because building such platforms requires large amounts of Bitcoin as collateral or reserves, creating real demand. Over the long term, if Strategy succeeds, it could help shift Bitcoin from a “speculative asset” to a “value asset,” attracting more traditional investors. The risk is that crypto lending is highly sensitive to market sentiment (for example, sharp Bitcoin price swings could trigger a liquidity crisis). Strategy therefore needs to manage risk like a traditional bank. Historically, platforms like FTX are an example: rapid scale expansion led to risks getting out of control.

Trading approach
💡 Bullish on a short-term rebound in Bitcoin, because these services enhance Bitcoin’s financial attributes and support its position as a store of value. The key price range to watch is $108.06K–80K. If Bitcoin falls below this range, the thesis is invalid.

深度解读

Strategy 的这种定位意义重大，意味着加密货币服务从简单的交易/托管，向更复杂的金融服务进阶。这背后是比特币价值存储属性被更多机构认可的体现——既然比特币是"数字黄金"，那围绕它的借贷、投资等衍生需求就会爆发。同时，监管环境趋稳（比如美国可能给 Crypto 单独开路）也鼓励这类平台发展，他们本质上在帮比特币争取更多像银行一样的角色。

短期来看，矿工活动暗示 $108.48K 下方支撑较强，但不足以推动价格上涨。如果未来一周 BTC 跌破 $79,000，矿工可能会因为亏损而减少算力，届时 $108.48K 的支撑将不复存在。这意味着当前阶段是投资者观察资金流向的关键窗口，ETH 的 $2,582.42 也需要观察是否有类似迹象。

操作思路
💡 我认为 BTC 在 $108.48K 处形成短期区间震荡，如果跌破 $79,000，矿工减产风险会显著增加。当前算力稳定是支撑，但不足以构成上涨动力。如果下周出现减产迹象（如算力下降超过 5%），这个判断作废。

回老家，碰见个老同学，差不多十年没见了。我说，见一次少一次，每一次都可能是最后一次。她嫌这话晦气，但这世上，意外本身就是无处不在的。
聊起人的命数，我讲了我娘死里逃生的事。我爹听信偏方，非用丹参熬水给我娘降血压，把降压药停了。结果我娘上完厕所一起身，短暂失忆了。一量血压，飙到了220，差点人就没了。后来在生日宴上，我爹非但没有后怕，反而扯起村里谁家看病没去急诊，结果回家就去世了的事。他表达的意思是，别人愚昧，他聪明。在这个事上，他必须赢一把。
我爹这种人，没有主体性，存在感全靠对比来确立。骨子里永远是紧绷的，事事都要争个高下。
老同学是个老师，她说现在的学生也是这样。苦大仇深，没有快乐，就是机械地上学。我说，穷孩子出身的通病，浑身都紧。相反，她教过一个家里有钱的调皮学生，以前被她叫到操场上严厉训斥过。后来人家出国留学，回来搞无人机，现在非常牛逼了。

🚨 A two-layer network netted $4.5 million in daily fees; Ethereum only got $400. “The more prosperous the second layer, the more the first layer profits” — we need to question that.

Group: [点击进入玖玖的粉丝群](https://app.binance.com/uni-qr/YXXQJrPb)

First, make a judgment: even if the execution layer is bustling, the settlement layer may not necessarily get the meat. This mismatch is already laid out in plain sight.

First layer: the numbers are straightforward. On September 3rd, on-chain analysis shows that a top-tier brokerage’s two-layer network reached daily fees of $4.5 million. Ethereum, which only provides data publishing and proofs for it, received just $400. One charges a few million, the other charges a few hundred — a difference of over ten thousand times. The gap is right there.⚖️

Second layer: where does the money go? The analysis concludes that the two-layer fees mainly stay circulating within its own ecosystem and do not flow back to the first layer proportionally. In other words, the more active the L2 transactions are, the more Ethereum’s settlement income doesn’t necessarily rise. It’s increasingly like a cheap public settlement “pad”—more like a transfer of value than shared value.🏦

Third layer: look at the structure. What the first layer gets now is only the fees for data publishing and proofs, and this part of income isn’t strongly tied to the two-layer’s transaction volume. Treating the second layer as a pipe that “bleeds” value into the first layer is a premise that isn’t solid. As modularized division of labor continues to deepen, this kind of revenue mismatch will only become more obvious, not automatically corrected.

Of course, there are those who say the first layer shouldn’t live on two-layer fees in the first place; security and final settlement are what it’s worth. I agree with half of that. But if the second layer is raking in profits handsomely while the first layer only collects a small slice, over time, people holding ETH will inevitably ask: where exactly is the value of this chain actually settling?

What’s truly worth discussing isn’t how much money a particular chain charges, but rather, once execution and settlement are completely separated, who should have the value attributed to them. If the execution layer keeps users and fees in its own pocket, even if the settlement layer remains secure, it’s still hard to share in the growth’s “slice of the pie.” One side says this is the inevitable outcome of modular specialization; the other says this is the beginning of value leaking out. Which side are you on?👀

Ethereum Market Deep-Dive Analysis: A Tug-of-War Between Upgrade Expectations and Capital Outflows

1. Price Trend Analysis

As of September 20, 2026, Ethereum’s spot price is $2,574. In the past few hours, it has shown a slight oscillating movement. From hourly candlestick charts, ETH has been fluctuating between $2,567 and $2,587, and overall it has maintained a relatively high-range position above $2,500.

Recent Ethereum price action is something of a mixed bag. Previously, ETH rose by 5.6% at one point, reaching $2,620. Whale activity has increased significantly, the number of non–zero-balance wallets has hit a new historical high, and this points to widespread accumulation. However, spot Ethereum ETFs recorded a net outflow of $140 million over the past week, which stands in sharp contrast to the major inflows seen in Bitcoin ETFs—this has put some pressure on the price.

From a more macro perspective, Ethereum’s exchange rate versus Bitcoin is rising rapidly and has broken through a key resistance level. This suggests that capital is rotating from Bitcoin into altcoins. With the altcoin season signal growing stronger, ETH—as a leader among altcoins—could benefit from this round of capital rotation.

2. Interpretation of Technical Indicators

From the moving average system: the 7-hour moving average is at $2,577, which is almost the same as the current price. The 25-hour moving average is at $2,610 and acts as overhead resistance. The 99-hour moving average is at $2,527, providing support for the medium- to long-term trend. The short-term moving averages are flattening; the price repeatedly oscillates around them, making directional selection imminent.

The Bollinger Bands indicator shows the upper band at $2,658, the middle band at $2,603, and the lower band at $2,547. Price is running below the middle band, but there is still room before reaching the lower band, indicating the market is in a neutral-to-weak region. Bandwidth is narrowing as well, which also signals that a directional breakout is likely approaching.

For the MACD indicator: the DIF line is at -10.67, the DEA line at -6.88, and the histogram at -3.80. Although MACD is still running below the zero line, the histogram’s negative values are shrinking rapidly, and bearish momentum is clearly weakening. If the DIF line crosses above the DEA line, it will form a short-term golden cross signal.

The RSI indicator shows: the 6-period RSI is 41.99, the 12-period RSI is 38.93, and the 24-period RSI is 47.42. RSI across all periods is in the neutral zone—neither overbought nor oversold—suggesting the market is in a wait-and-see state.

The KDJ indicator has shown positive changes: the K value rises from 16.87 to 39.62, the D value rises from 18.23 to 27.87, and the J value reaches 63.13. All three lines are moving upward together, meaning short-term rebound energy is building.

Overall, even though the composite indicator currently signals bearishness, with a win rate of 70.97%, among 15 factors, 11 are issuing buy signals while only 4 issue sell signals. The bull-side ratio is as high as 73.33%. When factor signals diverge from the composite signal, it often indicates that the trend is about to shift.

3. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum’s current market sentiment can be summarized as cautious optimism. The biggest positive catalyst comes from the upcoming GlAmsterdam upgrade. Ethereum has confirmed that it will conduct a stress test on the Sepolia testnet on October 6. The goal is to achieve faster transaction speeds, lower fees, and better scalability. 一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年九月二十日，以太坊现货价格报两千五百七十四美元，在过去数小时内呈现小幅震荡走势。从小时级别K线来看，ETH在两千五百六十七美元至两千五百八十七美元之间波动，整体维持在两千五百美元上方的相对高位区间运行。

近期以太坊的价格走势可谓喜忧参半。此前ETH曾一度上涨百分之五点六触及两千六百二十美元，鲸鱼活动显著增加，非零钱包数量创下历史新高，显示出广泛的积累态势。然而，现货以太坊ETF在过去一周录得一点四亿美元的净流出，与比特币ETF的大幅流入形成鲜明对比，这对价格形成了一定的压制。

从更宏观的角度来看，以太坊对比特币的汇率正在快速攀升并突破关键阻力位，这暗示着资金正在从比特币向山寨币轮动。在当前山寨币季节信号日益强烈的背景下，ETH作为山寨币的领头羊有望受益于此轮资金轮动行情。

二、技术指标解读

从移动均线系统来看，七小时均线位于两千五百七十七美元，与当前价格基本重合。二十五小时均线位于两千六百一十美元，对价格构成上方阻力。九十九小时均线位于两千五百二十七美元，为中长期趋势提供了支撑。短期均线趋于走平，价格围绕短期均线反复震荡，方向选择迫在眉睫。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于两千六百五十八美元，中轨位于两千六百零三美元，下轨位于两千五百四十七美元。价格运行在中轨下方，但距离下轨仍有空间，说明当前处于中性偏弱区域。带宽正在收窄，同样预示着即将出现方向性突破。

MACD指标方面，DIF线位于负十点六七，DEA线位于负六点八八，柱状图为负三点八零。MACD虽然仍在零轴下方运行，但柱状图的负值正在快速缩小，空头动能明显减弱。如果DIF线能够上穿DEA线，将形成短期金叉信号。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI为四十一点九九，十二周期RSI为三十八点九三，二十四周期RSI为四十七点四二。各周期RSI均处于中性区域，既未超买也未超卖，表明市场处于观望状态。

KDJ指标出现积极变化，K值从十六点八七上升至三十九点六二，D值从十八点二三上升至二十七点八七，J值更是达到六十三点一三。三线同时向上运行，短期反弹动能正在积聚。

综合来看，虽然复合指标当前信号为看空，胜率百分之七十点九七，但十五个因子中有十一个发出做多信号，仅四个发出做空信号，多头占比高达百分之七十三点三三。这种因子信号与复合信号的背离，往往预示着趋势即将发生转变。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的市场情绪可以用谨慎乐观来概括。最大的利好来自即将到来的Glamsterdam升级。以太坊已经确认将于十月六日在Sepolia测试网上进行压力测试，目标是实现更快的交易速度、更低的费用和更好的可扩展性，主网上线预计将在二零二六年第四季度完成。这一重大技术升级预期为ETH提供了坚实的基本面支撑。

从链上数据来看，质押承诺数据极为亮眼，等待质押的ETH数量是退出质押的十三点六倍，表明持有者的信心非常坚定，流通供应将持续减少。这种供需结构的改善，长期来看将对ETH价格形成有力支撑。

然而，风险因素同样不容忽视。首先，ETF资金的持续流出短期内压制了价格表现。其次，如果价格跌破两千五百零九美元，将触发累计约十一点四七亿美元的多头仓位清算风险，这在MACD交叉和RSI下行的背景下需要高度警惕。此外，二层网络正在捕获不成比例的手续费收入，Robinhood Chain日收入达四百五十万美元，而支付给以太坊基础层的仅有四十万美元，这种价值捕获的失衡对基础层的经济积累构成潜在威胁。

展望未来，如果Glamsterdam升级顺利推进，叠加山寨币季节的资金轮动效应，ETH有望在第四季度向三千美元发起冲击。短期内，两千五百五十美元是关键的支撑位，而两千六百二十美元则是需要突破的阻力位。建议投资者密切关注升级进展和ETF资金流向，在控制风险的前提下把握布局机会。

Why Crypto Liquidations Happen — A Beginner’s Guide 📉

One thing I wish I understood earlier about crypto is liquidation.

You may have seen the word “liquidation” during a big market move, but what actually happens when a crypto position gets liquidated?

Here’s the simple version 👇

1️⃣ LEVERAGE

Leverage allows traders to control a position larger than the amount of margin they put up.

It can increase potential gains, but it also increases potential losses.

2️⃣ THE MARKET MOVES AGAINST THE POSITION

If the price moves against a leveraged position, the trader’s available margin can start decreasing.

The higher the leverage, the less room there may be for the position to move against the trader.

3️⃣ LIQUIDATION

If the available margin becomes insufficient to maintain the position, the exchange can automatically close the position.

That forced closing is called liquidation.

And here is the part many beginners miss:

When many leveraged positions are liquidated around the same time, those forced trades can add extra buying or selling pressure and contribute to faster market moves.

That’s why a sudden crypto move can sometimes become much more intense than it initially looked.

My biggest takeaway:

Understanding leverage and liquidation is just as important as understanding the coin itself.

Don’t trade something you don’t understand.

Educational content only. Crypto involves risk. Always do your own research.

On the other hand, as the market share of decentralized stablecoins expands, regulators may take another look at compliance pathways in the crypto space. Has anything similar happened before? When Ethereum Gas fees spiked in 2019, the Stablecoin P pool also saw a similar phenomenon, though on a far smaller scale than this time.

But this conclusion has a caveat—if the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) tightens approval standards for stablecoin issuance licenses within the next three months, USDG’s rapid growth could quickly stall.

“Why hasn’t the coin in my hand surged sharply? Why haven’t I even outperformed Bitcoin?”

This question itself is worth rethinking.

The entire crypto market now tracks more than 20,000 digital assets. On just the major trading platforms, the number of listed tokens alone is already in the thousands—never mind the new coins being created every day.

So what we should truly ask has never been:

“Why hasn’t my coin gone up?”

But rather: “Why should so many coins rise together?”

Capital is limited, and so is attention.

In the past few months, I’ve kept emphasizing that when the number of assets keeps swelling while capital becomes increasingly concentrated in a small set of top-tier assets, the market can absolutely show a pattern where the overall index rises, Bitcoin rises, and even some of the leading altcoins rise—while a large number of tokens still don’t move, and even continue to underperform Bitcoin.

This is not an abnormal phenomenon.

The coins I hold also include some assets that haven’t outperformed Bitcoin. But I’m not in a hurry. As long as the market is still operating within a trend framework, I won’t be anxious.

Worrying doesn’t help. It’s clear the market has started creating new layers of liquidity, and in the future, capital will concentrate more and more toward the leaders in various sectors.

It’s not the case that if you buy tokens from the same sector, they must rise together as they did before. Even some weaker projects won’t only fail to rally together—they may end up going lower and lower.

We’re currently in the transition stage from a wild market to a mature market. In a given field, having 2–3 tokens survive and remain influential for a while is already a pretty good outcome.

截至北京时间9月21日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报2631.85美元，在过去24小时内表现出强劲的反弹势头。从小时K线数据来看，ETH在最近五个交易时段内最高触及2649.89美元，最低下探2606.69美元，整体在2600美元至2650美元区间内运行，展现出较强的抗跌能力。

均线系统方面，7周期均线报2622.43美元，25周期均线报2602.78美元，99周期均线报2544.44美元，短中长期均线呈现标准的多头排列。价格稳定运行在所有主要均线之上，7周期EMA为2621.45美元，25周期EMA为2607.83美元，99周期EMA为2563.65美元，均线系统向上发散的趋势明确。

📰 Why U.S. sanctions on the Iran crypto exchange BitBank make the market think more?

The U.S. Department of the Treasury said it has removed Iran’s Hormuz Safe platform from the sanctions list, but only on the condition that it must transfer all payments collected since June via the sanctioned crypto exchange BitBank. This means BitBank played a key role in transferring funds for Iran’s IRGC, which led to it being added to the sanctions list.

Why is this news important?
At its core, the matter once again highlights the vulnerability of cryptocurrencies in anti–money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) requirements. The Hormuz Safe platform was originally intended as one of the channels to bypass financial sanctions against Iran, while BitBank became a crucial intermediary in that chain. This shows that even if crypto trading is designed to be decentralized, regulators may still target it whenever centralized payment processing is involved.

In the industry cycle, regulatory trends, or capital flows, this event sits at a critical point. It is not only a strengthening of sanctions against Iran, but also a slap on the compliance of the entire crypto industry. Tied to other recent developments—for example, the U.S. stepping up regulation of DeFi projects—everything points in the same direction: regulators are gradually tightening their control over the crypto space.

Market impact
The impact on BTC/ETH prices may cause short-term sentiment volatility, but the long-term trend is unlikely to change as a result. The market has already been anticipating compliance-related issues with crypto, so this news is more like confirmation of existing concerns. For the overall market structure, it could push more exchanges to strengthen their AML policies, thereby changing the flow of some capital. Historically, similar incidents—such as Bitfinex being fined over a dispute with SIFMA—have shown that regulators will take tough action when necessary.

Trading/operations ideas
💡 For the market, this event is more like a confirmation signal, meaning scrutiny of crypto compliance is entering a new phase. If more news emerges later about sanctions being imposed on crypto platforms, this conclusion would no longer hold. For now, $BTC and $ETH may see some fluctuations in the short term, but the long-term trend will not change because of this.

REX's newly launched ASSX fund directly amplifies the price volatility of Bitcoin wallet company Strive by 2x, giving traders a new way to bet on shifts in how Bitcoin wealth is distributed. Strive makes money by helping large miners manage their funds. Now, as its stock rises and falls with BTC, ASSX turns those indirect returns into a pure leveraged game. For ordinary people, this could mean that the value of Bitcoin wallets may be interpreted as being amplified.

Why is this news important?
This news isn’t just a simple extension of Bitcoin ETFs—it offers the market a new idea: how to use derivatives to play with Bitcoin’s “shadow value.” Strive’s stock price directly reflects big holders’ willingness to accumulate coins, and ASSX multiplies that sentiment by 2. At its core, institutions are using financial engineering to make the “Bitcoin wallet index” tangible. With BTC recently fluctuating, demand has grown for those who want to participate in wallet growth but don’t want to buy coins directly.

Impact on the market
ASSX’s arrival on BTC can be seen in three phases:
1. In the short term, sentiment is expected to drive BTC up by 200–300 points, because this is the first real tool that turns “wallet value” into a leveraged product.
2. In the medium term, the landscape will shift: previously, you could only indirectly participate through large purchases of Strive, but now ASSX lets capital flow more directly into this track, potentially squeezing traditional ETF shares.
3. Regulatory risk is the hidden thread. If institutions use ASSX heavily to take BTC positions, the U.S. CFTC may revisit the compliance of this “Bitcoin shadow futures” concept.

A historical reference is 2021, when Bitwise’s Bitcoin spot ETF was first launched—it led to a surge in demand for related derivatives. ASSX may follow a similar path this time, but with higher and more direct leverage.

Trading approach
💡 This news suggests BTC may see a short-term sentiment-driven rally, especially since BTC is currently at a key 81K level. If, after ASSX is launched, the first week can hold above $1.5, this ETF could become a new driver for BTC’s upside. REX新出的ASSX基金直接2倍放大比特币钱包公司Strive的股价波动，给想赌比特币财富分配变局的交易员开了新玩法。Strive本身就靠帮大矿工管钱发家，现在它股价跟着BTC涨跌，ASSX让这种间接收益变成纯粹的杠杆游戏。对普通人来说，意味着比特币的钱包价值可能被放大解读。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这条新闻不是比特币ETF的简单延伸，而是给了市场一个新思路：如何通过衍生品玩转比特币的"影子价值"。Strive的股价直接反映了大户们囤币意愿，而ASSX是把这个情绪乘以2。本质是机构在用金融工程把"比特币钱包指数"具象化。近期BTC价格震荡，让这种想直接参与钱包增值但不想直接买币的诉求变得强烈。

对市场的影响
ASSX的出现对BTC的影响分三阶段：
1. 短期情绪面，预计会给BTC带来200-300点涨幅，因为这是第一个真正把"钱包价值"变成杠杆产品的工具
2. 中期格局会变，以前只能通过大额买入Strive间接参与，现在ASSX让资金更直接地流向这个赛道，可能挤压传统ETF的份额

Ethereum Market In-Depth Analysis: ETH/BTC Ratio Breaks Through, With $2,600 Holding Firm

September 20, 2026

1. Price Trend Analysis

As of the early hours of September 20 Beijing time, Ethereum spot is quoted at $2,631. Over the past few hours, it has been trading in the range of $2,585 to $2,650. From the hourly K-line chart, after touching a short-term high of $2,648, ETH pulled back slightly and then consolidated narrowly around $2,626, showing relatively strong resilience against declines.

The most notable recent change in the Ethereum market is that the ETH/BTC ratio has broken above a five-year descending trendline. This technical signal is interpreted by the market as an important indication of capital rotating from Bitcoin into Ethereum, suggesting investors’ confidence in the Ethereum ecosystem is rebounding. Despite the macro pressure brought by Fed rate hikes, Ethereum has still maintained comparatively strong performance.

From a fundamentals perspective, Ethereum spot ETFs recorded net inflows of $143.7 million on September 18, reversing the net outflow trend from the previous week. The re-entry of institutional capital further validates the market’s recognition of Ethereum’s long-term value. In addition, ongoing development progress in privacy technology and native Rollups within the Ethereum network has injected momentum into the ecosystem’s long-term growth.

2. Interpretation of Technical Indicators

Regarding moving averages, the 7-period moving average is $2,614, the 25-period moving average is $2,603, and the 99-period moving average is $2,542. The price is trading above all major moving averages. The short-, mid-, and long-term moving averages are aligned in a bullish order, and the overall trend structure is healthy. Notably, the 7-period moving average has just crossed above the 25-period moving average, forming a short-term golden cross that provides dynamic support for the price.

The Bollinger Bands indicator shows the upper band near $2,641, the midline around $2,595, and the lower band around $2,549. The current price is running in the upper region between the midline and the upper band, indicating that bullish momentum is dominant, though it has not yet reached an extreme overbought condition.

For MACD, the DIF line has crossed above the DEA line, and the histogram continues to expand to 6.02, with bullish momentum gradually strengthening. RSI (6 periods) is 70.34—entered a relatively high area but has not yet touched the overbought line. RSI (12 periods) is 61.93, sitting in a neutral-to-bullish range, leaving additional room for further upside from a technical standpoint.

In the KDJ indicator, the K line is 73.69, the D line is 70.44, and the J line is 80.19. Overall, the indicator is in a high zone, but there is no clear “dead cross” signal yet. Trading volume expanded during the breakout phase and shrank noticeably during the pullback, suggesting limited sell pressure and good chip consolidation/locking.

3. Market Sentiment Analysis

Statistics on Ethereum’s long/short factors show that among 15 technical factors, 8 issue long signals, 6 issue short signals, and 1 is neutral. The proportion of long factors is 53.33%, overall slightly bullish. Even though the combined indicators lean bearish, the win rate is above 70%, indicating the current signals have relatively strong reference value.

From the market sentiment perspective, Ethereum’s recent strong performance is the result of a convergence of multiple positive factors. First, the trend break in the ETH/BTC ratio has attracted a large number of technical traders, and the capital rotation effect is evident. Second, improving ETF fund flows reflect a rebound in institutional allocation demand. In addition, the ongoing development of the Ethereum ecosystem in DeFi, NFTs, and Layer 2 continues to provide fundamental support for token value.

Risks to watch include: RSI has entered a somewhat high area in the short term, so a technical pullback is possible; there have been frequent network security incidents recently, and smart contract vulnerabilities may affect market confidence; and macro-level upward pressure on interest rates remains a looming “Damocles’ sword” over risk assets.

Overall, Ethereum appears to have achieved technical support around the $2,600 area in the short term. The medium-term trend is bullish, but investors should watch whether resistance near $2,650 can be broken. It is recommended that investors, while controlling position size, monitor the subsequent movement of the ETH/BTC ratio and the sustainability of ETF fund inflows.

以太坊市场深度分析：ETH/BTC比率破位，两千六百美元站稳脚跟

2026年9月20日

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月二十日凌晨，以太坊现货报价两千六百三十一美元，过去数小时在两千五百八十五美元至两千六百五十美元区间内运行。从小时K线来看，ETH在触及两千六百四十八美元的短期高点后小幅回落，随后在两千六百二十六美元附近窄幅整理，表现出较强的抗跌性。

近期以太坊最引人注目的变化是ETH/BTC比率突破了长达五年的下降趋势线。这一技术信号被市场解读为资金从比特币向以太坊轮动的重要标志，表明投资者对以太坊生态系统的信心正在回升。尽管美联储加息带来宏观层面的压力，以太坊依然保持了相对强势的表现。

从基本面来看，以太坊现货ETF在九月十八日录得一点四三七亿美元的净流入，扭转了此前一周的净流出态势。机构资金的重新入场进一步验证了市场对以太坊中长期价值的认可。此外，以太坊网络在隐私技术和原生Rollup方面的开发进展也为生态系统的长期发展注入了动力。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期均线报两千六百一十四美元，二十五周期均线报两千六百零三美元，九十九周期均线报两千五百四十二美元。价格位于所有主要均线上方，短中长期均线呈多头排列，趋势结构健康。值得注意的是，七周期均线刚刚上穿二十五周期均线形成短期金叉，为价格提供了动态支撑。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于两千六百四十一美元附近，中轨约两千五百九十五美元，下轨约两千五百四十九美元。当前价格运行在布林带中轨与上轨之间偏上位置，表明多头力量占优但尚未达到极端超买状态。

MACD方面，DIF线已上穿DEA线，柱状图持续放大至六点零二，多头动能逐步增强。RSI六周期报七十点三四，已进入偏高区域但尚未触及超买线，十二周期报六十一点九三，处于中性偏多区间，仍有进一步上行的技术空间。

KDJ指标中K线报七十三点六九，D线报七十点四四，J线报八十点一九，整体处于高位区域但尚未出现明显的死叉信号。成交量在冲高阶段有所放大，回落阶段明显缩量，显示卖压有限，筹码锁定良好。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊的多空因子统计显示，十五个技术因子中有八个发出做多信号，六个发出做空信号，一个中性，做多因子占比百分之五十三点三三，整体略偏多头。综合指标虽然信号偏空，但胜率高达百分之七十以上，说明当前信号的可参考性较强。

从市场情绪面来看，以太坊近期的强势表现与多个利好因素共振。首先，ETH/BTC比率的趋势性突破吸引了大量技术派交易者的关注，资金轮动效应明显。其次，ETF资金流的改善反映了机构配置需求的回暖。此外，以太坊生态在DeFi、NFT和Layer2领域的持续发展也为代币价值提供了基本面支撑。

需要警惕的风险包括：RSI短期已进入偏高区域，存在技术性回调的可能；近期网络安全事件频发，智能合约漏洞可能影响市场信心；宏观层面的利率上行压力仍是悬在风险资产上方的达摩克利斯之剑。

综合判断，以太坊短期在两千六百公里附近获得技术性支撑，中期趋势偏多但需关注上方两千六百五十美元阻力的突破情况。建议投资者在控制仓位的前提下，关注ETH/BTC比率的后续走势以及ETF资金流的持续性。

translatedData.content:
People who were still抢 call on Friday are turning around on Saturday to buy crash insurance.

On the IBIT options chain, put skew is rearing its head again—and it’s concentrated at strike prices that are deep out of the money. Translating into plain human language: institutions don’t necessarily think it *will* go down; they’re using cheap tickets—priced at a few bucks each—to hedge tail risk around the number $BTC . The deeper it goes, the cheaper it gets. The more volume they stack, the bigger the hedge. These positions usually don’t make noise in normal times. The day something actually goes wrong is when they finally “speak.”

At the same time, over on the contract side, the fight just ended: in the past 24 hours, the whole network liquidated 316 million, with both longs and shorts getting blown out—$SOL  led the declines by about two percentage points. The longs just finished placing their orders around 82k, while the shorts are waiting below 81k. Nobody left.

Night-shift traders understand this market best: in Asia’s early hours, the US and Europe are asleep. Liquidity is as thin as paper—just a few hundred BTC can push funding rates from negative to positive. Right now, $ETH  has funding slightly favoring longs, and $SOL  shows bearish cooling. Those two signals are basically twisting against each other, which suggests nobody has a real directional view. Everyone is scrambling to take the other side’s stop.

JPMorgan added one more line: if the ETF hedging flow starts unwinding, BTC might stand up before gold. Institutions talk about “hedging,” but their hands are full of options. Contract retail traders watch funding rates—these guys are watching volatility.

I’m not opening a position tonight. In this kind of market, you make money with patience, not quick hands. Just finished cleaning up the sandpit where the cat kicked things over—looked again, and the price is still the same.

#BTC #SOL #ETH #IBIT #FuturaKey

content:
周五还在抢 call 的人，周六转头去买暴跌保险。

IBIT 期权盘上，看跌偏斜重新抬头，而且扎堆在深度虚值的行权价——翻译成人话：机构不是觉得要跌，是在用几块钱一张的票给 $BTC 尾部风险上保险。越深越便宜，堆的量越大。这类仓位平时没动静，真出事那天才是它说话的时候。

同一时间，合约那头刚打完一仗：过去 24 小时全网爆仓 3.16 亿，多空双爆，$SOL 领跌 2 个多点。多头刚在 8 万 2 埋完单，空头在 8 万 1 下面等着，谁都没走。

夜班人群最懂这个盘：亚洲凌晨，欧美睡觉，流动性薄得跟纸一样，几百个 BTC 就能把费率从负打到正。$ETH 现在资金费率偏多，$SOL 看空缓和——两个信号拧着，说明没人真有方向，都在抢对方的止损。

摩根大通还补了一句：如果 ETF 的对冲盘开始平仓，BTC 可能比黄金先站起来。机构嘴上说避险，手里全是期权。合约散户在看费率，人家在看波动率。

我今晚不开仓。这种盘面赚的是耐心，不是手速。刚把猫蹬翻的砂盆收拾完，一看，价格还是那个价。

BTC Reclaims Above $80,000: On the surface it looks like a rebound, but underneath it more resembles a joint repair of sentiment and positioning.

After Bitcoin stalled on a crypto regulatory bill and the Federal Reserve raised rates by 25 bps, it nevertheless moved back above $80,000. Over the past week it has risen about 4.9%, and ETH has also rebounded to around $2,600. The market interpretation is that longs and shorts are divided; in the short term BTC is slightly more supported by the balance of factors. However, the driving force behind this leg up seems more like short-covering, the repair of risk sentiment, and easing pressure from ETF fund flows working together.

That said, spot buying still isn’t solid enough. As of the week of September 18, U.S. Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded net inflows of only about $6.2 million. On September 18 alone, there were inflows of around $433 million, but it still looks more like a recovery from prior outflows. To judge whether this rally can hold, we’ll need to see if ETF inflows can continue consistently, and whether the U.S. dollar and Treasury yields will strengthen again. One scenario is that funds keep passing the baton, slowly stabilizing prices above $80,000. Another scenario is insufficient follow-through: if that happens, the pullback after the initial push higher will be more pronounced.

Which trend do you lean toward: continuing to hold above $80,000, or a pullback first before reassessing?

Source: Odaily Planet Daily

It’s more suitable to confirm the direction using the upper boundary and confirm the holding using the lower boundary, while the midline is only used as the strength/weakness divider.

The three price levels that need to be tracked together are: midline 2,607.11, upper confirmation level 2,649.89, and lower defense level 2,564.33. The midline determines short-term initiative; the upper and lower boundaries determine whether the market truly breaks out of the original volatility range.

My scenario analysis is not a single-direction bet. If the price breaks above 2,649.89 and can hold, it means upside space is reopened; if it breaks below 2,564.33 and fails to rebound, it means the structure weakens further. If price moves between them, continue to observe the closing behavior on both sides of 2,607.11.

For those with existing positions, the key is to manage based on whether support has failed, not to let every fluctuation drag you around. For those currently on the sidelines, prioritize waiting for a breakout with a pullback or for confirmation of support. For spot positions, you can scale in; for contracts, you should shorten the decision chain—first define the stop-loss location, then decide whether to participate.

A trading plan must include invalidation conditions. If your judgment is correct, you can realize gains in stages. If your judgment is wrong, you must allow yourself to exit as well; you cannot use averaging-in to cover the fact that the original logic has changed. The market will update, and your viewpoint should adjust alongside price evidence.

Ethereum Market In-Depth Analysis: Upgrade Expectations Support the Price; $2,600 Is a Key Battleground

September 20, 2026

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of early September 21 Beijing time, Ethereum is quoted at $2,631. Over the past 24 hours, its performance has been relatively stable. Amid market volatility triggered by Fed rate hikes, Ethereum faced some downward pressure at one point. However, supported by both capital rotation effects and upgrade expectations, it held the $2,500 critical level and rebounded to above $2,630.

From the perspective of fund flows, the Ethereum ETF recorded a strong net inflow of $143.7 million on September 18, effectively reversing the prior net outflow trend. This data suggests institutional investors still remain optimistic about Ethereum’s long-term value. At the same time, there are signs of a breakout in the ETH/BTC exchange rate, indicating that funds are rotating from Bitcoin into Ethereum—providing support for Ethereum’s relative strength.

On-chain data shows that Ethereum’s staking queue remains persistently high, reflecting long-term holders’ confidence in network upgrades. The Glamsterdam upgrade is expected to be implemented in the fourth quarter of this year. Progress on privacy-related feature development has also injected new momentum into the Ethereum ecosystem. From the price structure, the $2,500 to $2,509 range is an extremely critical support zone. Below this level, there are more than $1.14 billion worth of long-leveraged positions. If this level is lost, it could trigger a cascade of liquidations.

II. Interpretation of Technical Indicators

Based on the aggregate indicators, there are currently 15 monitored factors at the 1-hour level: 8 bullish factors accounting for 53.3%, 6 bearish factors accounting for 40.0%, and 1 neutral factor accounting for 6.7%. Compared with Bitcoin, Ethereum’s bullish and bearish forces are more balanced, with a slight advantage for the bulls. The composite indicator value is zero, issuing a short-term bearish signal. The historical win rate is 68.57%.

The 14-period RSI is currently in a neutral state, with a win rate as high as 60.71%—one of the highest among all factors. This indicates that the RSI signal on Ethereum is relatively reliable. The current neutral reading means the price is neither set up for buying nor selling in the near term, and it may continue to trade in a range.

The 5-period moving average factor issues a bullish signal. The alpha7 factor, paired with a zero original value, forms an interesting technical combination. The alpha11 factor is also bullish; the original value of 1.205 shows strong upward momentum. However, the alpha23 factor issues a strong bearish signal with a value of negative 2.19, and alpha29 is also bearish with a value of negative 1.56. These two factors’ short pressure cannot be ignored. Overall, Ethereum’s technical picture suggests a slightly bullish, balanced stance between bulls and bears. In the near term, traders should focus on the breakout direction around the $2,650 resistance and the $2,580 support.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Overall, Ethereum’s market sentiment is leaning positive, but there is short-term pressure from profit-taking. From a fundamental standpoint, the approaching Glamsterdam upgrade is the biggest positive catalyst. This upgrade will further strengthen Ethereum’s privacy features and scalability, consolidating its leading position in the smart-contract platform sector. The high staking queue reflects strong community confidence in the upgrade; long-term holders have not been shaken by short-term volatility.

Capital rotation is another positive signal worth watching. As Bitcoin’s dominance falls back from its monthly high, the altcoin market begins to show seasonal signals. On the Binance platform, nearly 70% of altcoins have returned above their 200-day moving averages. Tokens such as UNI, ZEC, NEAR, ENA, and AVAX have recorded double-digit weekly gains. Although Glassnode shows that the median market cap among altcoins remains down 74% compared with two years ago—indicating the current rally is selective rather than a broad-based altcoin season—Ethereum, as a leading altcoin, stands to benefit from this round of rotation.

The key risk to watch is the risk of leveraged liquidation. More than $1.14 billion in long-leverage positions piled up below $2,509 create a major downside risk. If the price falls below this level, it could trigger large-scale chain liquidations. Additionally, earlier in the short term, RSI surged to an extreme level of 86. While it has since cooled off, it still suggests that profit-taking could emerge at any time. The incident involving an attack on Fetch.ai smart contracts also serves as a reminder for investors to pay attention to ecosystem security risks.
